25C nominal versus 30D labels in capacity/dynamic/PCPD and 30 Degree internal PCPD path.
Dynamic preparation absent; z0=1,h0=+1 explicitly authorized, not measured.

Processed repetition periods DST333/FUDS1442/US06435s differ from standard cycles; sheet naming is not independent official waveform certification.
M may change sign: retained without abs, clipping or target-dependent correction.

protocol.a123_selection: Lexicographically first specimen, chosen before fitting; A1-008 preserved and inventoried, not pooled or selected by performance.
protocol.simulation: Continuous, one initial state per profile; exact zero-order-hold RC and ESC transitions; SOC trapezoidal integration of measured current.
protocol.esc_units: Qnom stored in Ah and converted to coulombs (3600*Qnom) in dh/dt with time in seconds; gamma dimensionless per unit SOC throughput.

mendeley_initial_state.provenance: User authorized assumed full charge before each processed profile; preparation not present; provisional assumption, not inferred by OCV inversion.

protocol.ocv_A: 1001 equal-SOC bins, median voltage, isotonic monotonic denoising, PCHIP; common interval only, boundary hold outside.
protocol.ocv_B: 11 supplied points per branch; reconstruct SOC from PCPD pulse capacities with the same measured Qnom; charge starts at discharge endpoint; PCHIP without forcing monotonicity or nonnegative M.
protocol.ocv_boundary_policy: Hold each branch at common-interval boundary; retain unclipped SOC for stratification and count boundary samples explicitly.

optimizer.selection: Lowest full-profile squared residual among successful predetermined starts; no target tuning.

protocol.oracle: V4 fits degree-9 Chebyshev OCV and 2RC parameters on each evaluated profile; diagnostic leakage by design, never used in GO comparisons.

decision.saturation: fraction of all uniform-grid samples with abs(h) > 0.9
decision.GO: Both required profiles meet reduction >= 0.10 AND saturation < 0.90; otherwise NO-GO after a valid completed run.
decision.global: GO if and only if primary cell A is GO; B cannot alter global decision.
